reuse.why: Uses findOrCreateBank, assertBankAccountNotLinked and handleSyncResponse, but the link flow and the download function are wholesale copies of the Akahu/Pluggy versions rather than extracted shared helpers.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the URL and log label changed.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts provider code: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, types in types/models.

scope.why: Only the server-side changes the request needs, plus tests.

maintainability.why: Adds a fifth/sixth copy of the same link and download logic, so any fix to the shared flow must be repeated per provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing shared link or download abstraction exists to bypass; it uses findOrCreateBank and assertBankAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are plain copies with the provider name swapped, not disguised.
